searchText: Ever since polygon activated 1559 I noticed even the big apps like quickswap and 1inch set the priority fee = max fee, wonder how they get to that. And metamask has a really clunky ui to change things around 😆 Actually even metamask sets the priority fee to the max fee using their recommendations That’s usually because they are using and outdated web3js or ethers version 😕
